note: Synthetic historical incidents. Used as supporting evidence only; a similar past incident never proves the current root cause.

incidents.title: Fiber uplink failure caused loss of three downstream sites
incidents.topology_pattern: single-homed aggregation router, three dependent base stations
incidents.precursors: Rising CRC/interface errors on the uplink for about 3 minutes before the outage
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Fiber cut by third-party roadworks between the aggregation site and the core
incidents.resolution: Field team spliced the fiber; interface restored and verified

incidents.title: Congestion on surviving uplink after redundant uplink failure
incidents.topology_pattern: dual-homed aggregation router, one uplink lost
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Uplink A failed; all traffic shifted to uplink B which ran above 95% utilization
incidents.resolution: Uplink A repaired; temporary traffic-engineering policy applied under approval until then

incidents.title: Line-card interface hardware fault on aggregation router
incidents.precursors: Interface flapping several times over 20 minutes; optical receive power normal at the far end
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Failed line-card port; optics and fiber tested good
incidents.resolution: Traffic moved to spare port under approval, line card replaced during maintenance window

incidents.title: Routing change after configuration update isolated a region
incidents.topology_pattern: interfaces up at physical layer, routing adjacency lost
incidents.precursors: Configuration change committed 6 minutes before the first alarm
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Incorrect routing policy introduced in the change; interfaces were never down
incidents.resolution: Change rolled back under approval; adjacency re-established

incidents.title: Site power failure took down aggregation router and base stations
incidents.topology_pattern: whole device unreachable rather than a single interface
incidents.precursors: Mains failure alarm and battery-discharge warning from site monitoring
incidents.resolution: Generator dispatched; devices recovered after power returned

incidents.title: False CPU alarm caused by stuck telemetry sensor
incidents.precursors: Metric values perfectly flat for 10 minutes
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Monitoring agent returned stuck values; device healthy
incidents.resolution: Monitoring agent restarted; no network change needed

incidents.title: Routing process crash and automatic restart on core router
incidents.precursors: Memory use on the router had been growing for several hours
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Memory leak in a routing process led to a crash and automatic restart
incidents.resolution: Vendor patch scheduled; interim monitoring threshold added

incidents.title: Upstream transit provider outage degraded external connectivity
incidents.topology_pattern: fault outside the managed network; internal telemetry normal
incidents.confirmed_root_cause: Transit provider fiber outage confirmed by provider
incidents.resolution: Traffic switched to secondary provider under approval; provider repaired its link
